title: test(ui/scripts): take the vi-mock-inherit test's whole-repo readings once, at collection
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CY2n1JmZZKrHgtp9jC
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgP6XkfpjCfyzzG2KwQPUZfy)_
Fixes #27449

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`check-vi-mock-inherit.test.ts` 里读真实仓库的三个读数(全量 `scan`、门禁 CLI 一次运行、`@object-ui/i18n` 的 `scan`)每个文件只取一次,在 describe 体(收集阶段)里取,三个慢用例不再在自己的 15 秒预算里重扫整个仓库。
- 为什么改:这三个用例空闲各 5.4–6.0 秒、四核满载下 6.9–7.7 秒,再翻一倍负载就会贴近 15 秒超时,和 #27423 是同一形态。按裁决不调超时、不跳过、不重试、不改断言。
- 风险与回滚:只动一个测试文件,断言逐条不变;读数被冻结,用例之间无法互相污染;读数若抛错,错误被保存并只让读它的那个用例失败,不会在收集阶段弄死整个文件。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/scripts/__tests__/check-vi-mock-inherit.test.ts` 顶部新增的 `realTree` 备忘块(含 `once` / `warm`),以及 `repo state` 和 `the sweep` 两个 describe 体里的取值行。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/check-vi-mock-inherit.test.ts`,预期 83 passed,三个原慢用例各在约 1 毫秒内完成。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`ui/scripts/__tests__/check-vi-mock-inherit.test.ts` only. `scripts/check-vi-mock-inherit.mjs` is untouched: no seam was needed.

- A module-level `realTree` memo takes each whole-repository reading once per file: `gate` = `scan(repoRoot)`, `cli` = one run of `node scripts/check-vi-mock-inherit.mjs` over the tree, and `i18n` = `scan(repoRoot, { covered: [I18N], floors: {} })`. Values are frozen (arrays and plain objects, recursively) with the same `frozen()` helper #27437 introduced, so a case that sorted or spliced one in place would throw instead of leaking into the next case.
- `repo state — the gate is green on this tree` takes `realTree.gate()` (it already scanned in its body; now through the memo) and warms `realTree.cli` in its body. The case `puts the census in the verdict, so a reader sees the population` reads the held CLI output instead of spawning the CLI itself.
- `the sweep — every @object-ui/i18n factory inherits…` warms `realTree.i18n` in its body. `no @object-ui/i18n factory freezes the surface` and `walked a real population…` read the one held scan instead of each running its own.
- One addition over #27437's shape: `once()` also holds a reading that THREW and rethrows it to each case that reads it, and `warm()` takes the reading at collection without letting the throw escape. Without it, a red CLI (non-zero exit) would throw during collection and fail the whole file with 0 cases run; before this PR it failed only the census case. Measured below: the failure stays in that one case.

## Why

The ruling on the card: take each reading once per file, at collection, through a frozen memo, so no case walks the repo; never raise a timeout, skip, retry or change an assertion. Every `expect` line is byte-identical; only where the value comes from moved.

Collection is the right home. `ui/AGENTS.md` (测试纪律) puts warm-up cost where no test or hook timeout bounds it and rules out a `beforeAll`, whose 10 s `hookTimeout` is narrower than the 15 s `testTimeout`.

## Tests

Measured on this container (4 cores, a shared box). "Load" means four `node -e 'for(;;){}'` CPU burners beside the run, the method #27437 used. Every run went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`. Per-case durations come from vitest's JSON reporter; the file figure is its `Duration` line.

| leg | `puts the census in the verdict…` | `no @object-ui/i18n factory freezes…` | `walked a real population…` | file `Duration` (import / tests) | result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| before, idle | 5950 ms | 5627 ms | 5415 ms | 25.67 s (6.17 / 19.07) | 83/83 |
| before, load | 7748 ms | 6897 ms | 7373 ms | 33.12 s (7.56 / 25.08) | 83/83 |
| after, idle | 0.8 ms | 0.2 ms | 0.2 ms | 20.43 s (17.80 / 2.25) | 83/83 |
| after, load | 1.0 ms | 0.2 ms | 0.1 ms | 27.61 s (23.82 / 3.27) | 83/83 |

After the change the slowest cases in the file are the three `THE DEATH` legs (each spawns a child vitest over a temp root, not the repository): about 0.6 s idle and up to 1.0 s loaded. The collection phase grows by the readings it now takes, about 11.6 s idle and 16.3 s loaded; no timeout bounds that phase. The tests phase drops from 19.07 s to 2.25 s idle and from 25.08 s to 3.27 s loaded, and the file's total wall drops by about 5 s either way. The "after" rows were measured at the final head `2d8468bb` (after the merge of `main`).

Failure-locality probe (one run, then restored): the `cli` reading was pointed at a non-existent script, so the CLI exits non-zero. Result: `Tests 1 failed | 82 passed (83)`, the one failure being `puts the census in the verdict…` with `Error: Command failed: node scripts/no-such-gate.mjs`. The file was restored with `git checkout HEAD --` under a trap; proof: `git hash-object` equals `git rev-parse HEAD:<file>`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Acceptance notes

- `ui/` is a private workspace root (`"private": true`) and this is a test file, so nothing publishes: the PR carries `skip-changeset`.
- The card's "Done when" readings that need CI runs after merge are the seat's to read.
- No assignee and no reviewer were set on this PR: the project's routing rule asks nobody before the seat's ACCEPT and review.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (CI owns the lint run)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset. This one publishes nothing: it is a test file under the private `ui/` root, so the PR carries `skip-changeset`.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
